question: What is the smallest architectural intervention that could give Echo a persistent behavioral state channel capable of L2 without becoming mere FAISS retrieval or RiverBrain routing?

conceptual_position.problem: Echo's weights are never fine-tuned, so any behavior-changing mechanism must place some text in context for the model to read -- naively indistinguishable from retrieval.
distinguishing_properties: stored state is a derived/abstracted representation, not the verbatim original teaching exchange
the read/surface mechanism is a deterministic, bounded lookup, not a similarity search over unstructured history
the mutation step has explicit, inspectable provenance, not automatic/implicit logging

existing_reusable_infrastructure.already_proven: reads a small structured state file (self_model.json) and renders it into the system prompt on every real conversational entry point -- confirmed working across two independent prior audits
existing_reusable_infrastructure.consequence: the STATE_READ->BEHAVIOR half of the required chain does not need to be invented for Candidates 1/2, only a new state file and a new slice function following the same pattern

candidates.name: Minimal scalar/structured behavioral state
candidates.description: small, bounded, human-readable JSON file of named directives with explicit trigger keywords and a distilled instruction, mutated via a dedicated narrow function, read via deterministic keyword match, injected via the existing echo_ground_truth.py-style slice mechanism
chain: STATE_MUTATION (dedicated narrow function, discards original text)
RELOAD (fresh read at process start or per-call)
STATE_READ (deterministic keyword match, new small function)
BEHAVIOR (rendered into system prompt via existing slice-injection point)
candidates.confounds: FAISS re-presentation confound structurally impossible; honest residual: distilled directive is still text read in context, a real if narrower version of the same tension

candidates.name: Learned policy/rule store
candidates.description: append-only JSONL rule store, each entry {trigger_pattern, directive, provenance, confidence, created_at}, added via explicit learn_rule() call, read via deterministic regex/keyword pattern match (not embedding similarity), with conflict resolution for overlapping matches
chain: same shape as candidate 1, richer schema, real trigger-matching layer instead of flat keyword list
candidates.confounds: same text-in-context tension as candidate 1, plus false-positive trigger matches (a marker coincidentally appearing in an unrelated real conversation) which must be distinguished from genuine generalization
candidates.recommended_as: natural escalation from candidate 1 if conditional/compositional rules are later needed

candidates.name: Stateful, trained preference/policy layer
candidates.description: an incrementally-trained model (river-style online learning, analogous to RiverBrain) mapping prompt features to a content-steering directive via real-time inference
chain: BEHAVIOR (predicted directive injected into system prompt)
candidates.confounds: weakest of the three -- risks repeating RiverBrain's own confirmed-hollow classifier opacity problem (real training, no clean causal reach)
candidates.rejection_reason: its one real strength (generalization) is bought at direct cost to this mission's explicitly stated priorities: auditability, explicit provenance, deterministic boundaries, clean rollback

rejected_alternatives.reason: self-edit's deploy pathway runs with zero human review at write time per the P2 causal autopsy; repurposing it would import that risk profile and expand self-edit's own deliberately narrow current scope
would inherit RiverBrain's already-confirmed opacity problem (HoeffdingTreeClassifier read by exactly one self-referential consumer, no clean causal reach) rather than avoiding it

recommendation.escalation_path: candidate_2_learned_policy_rule_store, if genuine conditional/compositional rules are later needed, provided trigger-matching stays deterministic
recommendation.governance_default: human-confirmed commit for the mutation step (explicit command or a proposal held in a review queue until human-confirmed), mirroring the sibling preference-provenance package's own human_confirmation=True lifecycle gate and this project's own standing culture around autonomous, unreviewed extensions to any self-modifying capability

must_requirement_compliance.readable_by_ordinary_generation: satisfied -- reuses proven echo_ground_truth.py slice mechanism for candidates 1/2
